VR.title: Meta is Spinning out ‘Supernatural’ a Mere 3 Years After $400M Acquisition
VR.summary: Meta has spun out the VR fitness app Supernatural into an independent company, promising fresh content and a renewed focus on user experience.

VR.title: X-Plane & iRacing PC VR Streaming Clients Launched For Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: X-Plane 12 and iRacing are now playable in VR on Apple Vision Pro, enhancing the gaming experience with PC streaming and physical accessory integration.

VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are set to be sent to the International Space Station for astronaut training in collaboration with the European Space Agency.

VR.title: Supernatural To Return Under New Independent Company As Coaches Rejoin Platform
VR.summary: Supernatural is returning under a new independent company, reuniting original founders and coaches to continue the VR fitness service.

VR.title: Time-bending VR Puzzle Game UnLoop Gets Permanent Price Drop
VR.summary: The popular VR puzzle game UnLoop has received a permanent price drop across all supported platforms.

VR.title: This Quest Accessory Wants to Turn Your Brain Activity Into VR Avatar Control
VR.summary: Scotland-based PiEEG is launching a brain-computer interface accessory for Quest headsets, enabling real-time avatar control via brain signals.

AI.title: AI leaders call for tougher protections against AI-aided bioweapons
AI.summary: Tech leaders are urging US lawmakers to impose stricter regulations to prevent AI technology from being used to develop bioweapons.

AI.title: Amazon develops a warehouse robot that workers can speak to
AI.summary: Amazon unveiled a new version of its autonomous warehouse robot, Proteus, which can now interact with workers using natural language.

AI.title: TSMC struggles to keep up with AI demand: ‘We can only support so much’
AI.summary: TSMC's CEO revealed the company is struggling to meet the surging demand for AI chips despite ongoing factory expansions in the US.

AI.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
AI.summary: Microsoft announced new AI initiatives at its Build conference, signaling a competitive stance against OpenAI and other industry players.

AI.title: AI has a water problem — Google thinks it has a fix
AI.summary: Google aims to address environmental concerns related to its AI data centers by pledging to enhance water use for local communities.

AI.title: Amazon’s search bar will invent AI-generated products you can’t buy
AI.summary: Amazon's updated search bar will showcase AI-generated images of products based on user descriptions, enhancing the shopping experience.

NFL.title: Sources: Pack, WR Watson reach $110.5M deal
NFL.summary: The Packers and wide receiver Christian Watson have agreed to a four-year, $110.5 million contract extension, including a $31 million signing bonus.

NFL.title: Did New England finally get its WR1 in A.J. Brown?...
NFL.summary: A.J. Brown has been traded to the New England Patriots, potentially elevating their offense and impacting the Philadelphia Eagles.

NFL.title: Inside the latest Myles Garrett deal
NFL.summary: The Rams and defensive end Myles Garrett have finalized a new contract deal, solidifying his role on the team.

NFL.title: Browns sign DE Benton Whitley
NFL.summary: The Browns have signed free agent defensive end Benton Whitley, strengthening their defensive lineup.

NFL.title: QB Wilson announces retirement after 14 seasons
NFL.summary: Ten-time Pro Bowl quarterback Russell Wilson has announced his retirement from the NFL after 14 seasons, transitioning to a role with CBS Sports.

NFL.title: Lions rookie receiver Law tears ACL in practice
NFL.summary: Lions rookie wide receiver Kendrick Law suffered a torn ACL during practice, raising concerns about his season.
